title: Show active highlight when the activities switcher is open
line: The Activities panel button now shows the active highlight line while the activity switcher sidebar is open.
explanation: The Activities widget opens the activity switcher sidebar over D-Bus, and the sidebar belongs to the desktop view, so the widget had no way to know the sidebar was open and never drew the active line other panel widgets show while their popup is open. The switcher backend only knew about the Meta+Tab switcher mode. The backend now has an activityManagerOpen property that the desktop sets whenever its side panel switches to or away from the activity manager, and the widget draws the standard tabbar active indicator (same code as Show Desktop) while it is true.

commits.message:
applets/showActivityManager: highlight while the switcher is open

The Activities button gave no feedback while its sidebar was open. The
desktop now tells the switcher backend when the sidebar is shown, and
the applet then draws the same active indicator as other panel widgets.

BUG: 466404
